mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 725,000 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) below 1,300 thousand units signal broad demand weakness, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 725000 and HOUST < 1300, or the Rank IC for the RSAFS-HOUST interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 725,000 million dollars reflects strong consumer spending, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL YoY as a predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 persons signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200000, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals stagflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO-FEDFUNDS interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
